prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1036; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's alright. Can we just call me the claimant?

Q: That works for our file. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Conroe, Texas. I had just pulled into a spot near the store entrance and was walking back to my car with a bag of groceries.

Q: And what happened next?

A: A pickup truck was backing out of the space two rows over. I didn't see it coming because the view was blocked by a big SUV. It clipped the rear corner of my car as I stepped around the back bumper.

Q: Did you fall, or did you make contact with the vehicle?

A: I stumbled and my left leg twisted under me. I hit the pavement on one knee, and then I felt a sharp pain in the joint.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes. Someone from the store helped me sit down, and then I was taken to an urgent care clinic. They took X-rays and told me there may be ligament damage. I've been using a brace and crutches since then.

Q: Has anything about your mobility changed since the incident?

A: Yes, I can't climb stairs without help, and I've had to take time off work. I'm still going to physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I wasn't looking at my phone or doing anything unusual. I was just trying to get my groceries to the car.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the statement.
